name: path
meaning: the Trajectory it follows ({u16 count; Vec3s pts[count]}): PathFollower_Start 0x546ee3 reads pts[0] (+2/+4/+6); PathFollower_Step 0x546fb3 compares toIdx with count - 1. bipbip_PostLoadInit stores the first entry of the TRAJECTORY / TRAJ_WALL id list (0x4993e1, 0x4993fd)

name: speed
meaning: units per second: PathFollower_Start's argument (0x546ed4); 0x546c8e turns segment length * 1000 / speed into the rate. bipbip sets it to SPEED_TWO after the first segment (0x499897)

name: pos
meaning: the current position: Vec3s_LerpToTarget(&pos, points[fromIdx], t) every step (0x546f64); bipbip moves itself there (SetPosition 0x49992c) and draws its tunnel image from the wall path's one (0x499ac7)

name: segEnd
meaning: the point the current segment runs to: points[toIdx], or with smooth set the halfway point towards points[toIdx+1] (0x546cf8, 0x546d19-0x546d4f)

name: segStart
meaning: points[fromIdx], copied by Start and by Step when it moves to the next segment (0x546eec-0x546f0c, 0x547013-0x547049)

name: heading
meaning: 12-bit heading of the current segment, from atan2 in 0x546c8e (& 0xfff); bipbip faces it (0x499913)

name: smooth
meaning: 1 = cut corners through the halfway point (0x546c9a movzx/cmp 1); zeroed by Start and on every new segment (0x546eda, 0x546ff6)

name: fromIdx
meaning: index of the segment's start point: 0 from Start, +1 per segment (0x546ebf, 0x546fd2)

name: toIdx
meaning: index of the segment's end point: 1 from Start, +1 per segment; Step returns 2 instead of advancing when it is count - 1 (0x546ec8, 0x546fac-0x546fbd). bipbip leaves the road for the wall when it reaches count - 1 (0x4998a0)

name: rate
meaning: t per 1024 ms: 0x400000 / (segment ms) from 0x546c8e; t += rate * g_dtMs / 1024 per step (0x546f76-0x546f8a); 0 at the end of the path. bipbip copies the road's to the wall path (0x499909)
